schema.help: Tactile paving is a ridged or dotted ground surface that blind or visually impaired people can feel with a cane or their feet.

options.text: Tactile paving for blind or visually impaired people

ar.#Curb ramps at crossings: منحدرات عند حافة الرصيف في أماكن العبور
ar.#Tactile paving for blind or visually im: رصف لمسي لمن لديهم إعاقة بصرية
ar.#Tactile paving is a ridged or dotted gr: الرصف اللمسي سطح أرضي مضلّع أو منقّط يمكن لمن لديهم إعاقة بصرية تحسسه بالعصا أو بأقدامهم.

de.#Tactile paving for blind or visually im: Taktile Leitelemente für blinde oder sehbehinderte Personen
de.#Tactile paving is a ridged or dotted gr: Taktile Leitelemente sind gerillte oder genoppte Bodenflächen, die blinde oder sehbehinderte Menschen mit dem Stock oder den Füßen ertasten können.

en.#Tactile paving for blind or visually im: Tactile paving for blind or visually impaired people
en.#Tactile paving is a ridged or dotted gr: Tactile paving is a ridged or dotted ground surface that blind or visually impaired people can feel with a cane or their feet.

fa.#Curb ramps at crossings: رمپ لبه پیاده‌رو در محل‌های عبور
fa.#Tactile paving for blind or visually im: کف‌پوش لمسی برای افراد نابینا یا کم‌بینا
fa.#Tactile paving is a ridged or dotted gr: کف‌پوش لمسی سطحی شیاردار یا برجسته روی زمین است که افراد نابینا یا کم‌بینا می‌توانند با عصا یا پا آن را حس کنند.

fr.#Tactile paving for blind or visually im: Bande d’éveil à la vigilance pour les personnes aveugles ou malvoyantes
fr.#Tactile paving is a ridged or dotted gr: Les bandes podotactiles sont des surfaces au sol à stries ou à plots que les personnes aveugles ou malvoyantes peuvent sentir avec leur canne ou leurs pieds.

hu.#Tactile paving for blind or visually im: Taktilis burkolat vak vagy gyengénlátó személyeknek
hu.#Tactile paving is a ridged or dotted gr: A taktilis burkolat bordázott vagy pöttyös talajfelület, amelyet a vak vagy gyengénlátó emberek bottal vagy a lábukkal érzékelnek.

it.#Tactile paving for blind or visually im: Percorso tattile per persone cieche o ipovedenti
it.#Tactile paving is a ridged or dotted gr: Il percorso tattile è una pavimentazione a righe o a rilievi che le persone cieche o ipovedenti possono sentire con il bastone o con i piedi.
it.#Which accessibility features are availa: Quali elementi di accessibilità sono presenti?

tr.#Tactile paving for blind or visually im: Kör veya görme engelli kişiler için hissedilebilir yüzey
tr.#Tactile paving is a ridged or dotted gr: Hissedilebilir yüzey, görme engelli kişilerin bastonla veya ayaklarıyla hissedebildiği çizgili ya da kabarcıklı zemindir.
